svg.text: MAP2 Audio Platform — State Authority & Cluster Replication Architecture
Snapshot → JUCE Engine → etcd (Single Source of Truth) → Cluster Replication
LIVE confirmed on N of N channels
Plugin graph with PDC (Plugin Delay Compensation)
CPU monitor → Input copy → Param updates → Graph (PDC) → ...
Isolation: old & new graphs fully independent
F4 [RECONCILE/RECOVERY]: pull desired state from etcd
every 5s self-heal loop → compare saveGraphDocument() vs etcd desired
topology drift → report to management node
UI → POST activate (F1) → compile → VALIDATING → STAGING → APPLYING → F2 load_graph_document → crossfade
→ F9 commit etcd → VERIFYING → F3 observation push → F5 replicate peers → F6 peer reports → LIVE
MAP2 Audio Platform — SNAPSHOT_GRAPH_VERSION: 2026.04 etcd namespace: /map2/audio-state/v1 buffer: 64 samples @ 48kHz (1.33ms/period) Carbon Design System Dark Theme
